Game Overview

At its heart, Dockmaster is a simulation game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Dockmaster comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Dockmaster?

Dockmaster is a free simulation game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Dockmaster free to play?

Yes, Dockmaster is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
